programme.title: 1995 Collections: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Cheung Ka-shing and Man have been friends for many years and both of them are the owner of a garage. Cheung has invented a chip to win the sports car competition and gave the right to use the chip to Wen after the race. Cheung met a lovely girl, Kitty and fell in love with her at first sight. A landslide occurred the day before Kitty moved out of her house, Kitty and Cheung were trapped in the car. The president of a large Japanese Corporation came to Hong Kong to find Cheung. After the group study the function of the chip, they believed that the chip has a very big potential market value. Cheung is hailed as the next-generation empire of the automotive industry. Cheung and Man have started to invest in real estate, stock market and other businesses. Cheung meets Kitty again at a banquet but found that she has married. Cheung accidentally meets a supernatural master who can help Cheung dreaming with Kitty, therefore Cheung has become fascinated the dreaming with Kitty and pai

programme.title: The Happenings
programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience...

programme.title: Aces Go Places III
programme.desc: King Kong is commissioned by a man who claims to be Mr. Bond, special agent from the British Secret Service to recover for the Queen precious stones stolen from her crown which are now in Hong Kong. Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters, Mr. Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led by Mr. Bond. Carried out his mission successfully for Mr. Bond, King Kong is summoned by the Governor to assist Collins in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr. Bond's gang.

programme.title: In The Line Of Duty III
programme.desc: An armed couple breaks in the venue of the world-renowned jewelry designer Yamamoto's exhibition in Tokyo and takes away the most valuable pieces on display. The robbery ends in bloodshed. Inspector Fujioka's assistant is shot to death at the crime scene. The couple takes the jewelry to Hong Kong and Fujioka follows their trail. Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord...

programme.title: The Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Young Leong Tsan is nothing but a spoilt brat. He hates books and conventions but dotes on martial arts. His rich father loves him so much that handsome payments are awarded people who manage to lose gracefully to the son. Young Leong comes to think he is the best in Canton. A female impersonator, Yee Tai, rebuffs the amorous advances of one of Leong's friends. Leong comes to even the score, only to be defeated soundly by Yee Tai. Realizing that he is after all not good in kung fu, Leong stays behind with Yee Tai's operatic troupe as a coolie, hoping that Yee Tai would teach him the combat art some day...

programme.title: Future Cops
programme.desc: In the year 2043, the notorious villain is about to be put on trial. His killers decide to go back 50 years by the time tunnel, and look for the judge in his youthful age...

programme.title: Superstars Comedy: Let's Sing Along
programme.desc: Chu Wai Tak is a natural born introvert, a white collar worker who suffers from a serious lack of self confidence. Her greatest achievement at work is 'using 10% less toilet paper than yesterday' and saving several more cents. King's self confidence is at its peak as he has crowned himself the King of Karaoke. He becomes exhausted if he does not go to the karaoke box and sing for a few days. King loves to gain attention at the company and has indeed brought a lot of energy to a boring company...

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. What becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: E1 - The Force of Nature
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. What becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: E17
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 《山河之影》改編自路陽執導的同名系列電影《繡春刀》，講述兩位少年以赤子情懷協力衝破人生困境的江湖故事。 建文三年，雞鵝巷的小賊李霧濟南府金事王克恭攜萬貫家財平調進入南京城，便盜錦衣百戶李東方之名帖潛入王克恭府夢想著順利盜寶，在一夜之間坐擁菜華富貴。不料王克恭府中暗流湧動，李霧被迫捲入了一場圍繞魚瞑鎖展開的前朝火器之爭中，原本作為局外人的李霧成為了魚瞑鎖的持有者，陷入了漩渦中心。兒時，將李霧詔獄中解救的孩童宋真如今已成為錦衣衛陸錚，與李霧成了同僚，相見不相認；和李霧曾同處個囚室的女童舒棠變成了夜不收刺客，並跟李霧成了間諜夫妻，共同完成夜不收的任務。朝野紛爭的陰暗與殘酷讓三人之間的感情也在連環鎖樣的陰暗中經受著考驗。當改朝換代的那一刻到來的時候，所有的戰事和未解的迷局，都將落下帷幕。

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 《天啟異聞錄》講述了天啟年間，一場神秘疫病爆發，錦衣衛褚思鏡（黃軒飾）在孤島存亡危機中歷險破局的故事。 天啟年間，遼東關外怪病肆虐，人心惶惶，一錦衣衛隻身北上探查，不料卻卷入當地軍民鬥爭，在終日籠罩遼東的迷霧之後，武術詭譎陰謀也正潛滋暗長，無形的觸手正伺機而動……

programme.title: E17
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E3 - Gentle Lessons & Bedtime
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some gentle lessons & soothing bedtime songs. First, Twinkle learns about the importance of eating healthy, delicious fruit, like bananas, oranges & grapes. Then, help her find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck & cow make! After a long day of learning, it's time to get ready for bed. Listen as Twinkle & Mr. Moon sing a soothing nighttime lullaby to help you relax & drift off to sleep.

programme.title: E7 - JJ's Big Animal Adventure!
programme.desc: Go on a big animal adventure with JJ! The fun starts on Grandpa's farm, where JJ learns all about the animals & the sounds they make. He even helps give a sheep a bath! Then, it's time to head to the ocean. Join JJ & his family as they visit an aquarium & sing 'Baby Shark' with a real shark family! The adventure gets prehistoric when Ms. Appleberry teaches the class all about their favorite dinosaurs. From guessing games to meeting Bingo the dog, it's a wild day!

programme.title: E2 - Nina's Adventures with Friends
programme.desc: Join Nina on some amazing adventures with her friends! When Nina challenges her school friends to a game of soccer, she imagines herself as a true soccer star playing in a giant stadium at the World Cup! Then, she visits Grandpa's farm where she proves to be an ace tractor driver who never leaves her friends behind. From learning to share a new firetruck to going on an epic chase to get back a lost surprise egg, it's always an adventure with Nina!

programme.title: E1 - Join JJ's Fun Learning Club!
programme.desc: Come on & join JJ's fun learning club! The adventure starts with a field trip to the farm where JJ & his friends learn to count to ten using apples. The learning continues in the classroom as Ms. Appleberry sends the kids on a scavenger hunt to find items in every color of the rainbow. Even lunchtime is fun, as the family finds all the different shapes in JJ's lunch! From taking care of pets to learning yoga, there's always something new to learn!

programme.title: E1 - Awesome Animal Facts!
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He & D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, & even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool & discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Old Boy (Digital Restored Version)
programme.desc: One night in 1988, ordinary-man OH Dae-su, who lives with his wife and an adorable baby daughter, is kidnapped. He later wakes up to find himself in a private makeshift prison. While suffering from his debacle, Dae-su becomes shocked when he watches the news and hears that his beloved wife was brutally murdered. 15 years later, Dae-su is released and he determines to find out the truth. He meets Mi-do, the cook of the restaurant Dae-su has his first-meal after his imprisonment, and tells her about his 15 years in confinement. Mi-do promises to help him seek vengeance. As the team approaches the truth, another shocking-secret is revealing....

programme.title: Masquerade Night
programme.desc: An anonymous letter is delivered to the police – a warning that the killer involved in a mysterious homicide that occurred a few days ago in a condominium in Tokyo will strike again at “Masquerade Night”, the New Year's Eve countdown party held at Hotel Cortesia, Tokyo. All 500 invitees will be in costume. Everyone is a suspect. As the masked guests begin to arrive, they struggle to find a clue which will lead them to the murderer. Midnight draws near as the number of suspects increases. What is the killer's intention? Who is the informant? Will Nitta and Yamagishi be able to unveil the truth hidden behind the murderer's mask before the time limit?
